Track Name: Moh Maaya
Singer, Composer, Lyrics: Saah Goswami
Music Director: Shamir Tandon

Music Operations Head : Tannishtha Puri & Anany Kakade
Audio Post Production: Gopal Thakare
Tech Supervision: Madhur Hatiskar

Lyrics:
  
Prem mero nirwastra khadyo
[My love stood completely bare]
 
Or deh pe koi daag nahi
[And there is not a single blemish upon my love]
 
Tere naam ki bhasm ramau na
[Until I cover myself in the sacred ash of your name]
  
Tab tak puro bairaag nahi
[Until then, my renunciation is not complete]
 
 
[Verse 1]
  
Jitna bhi raaz mera tanne main bataya baithyo
[All my secrets had been revealed to you.]
  
Chhod ke makaan teri gali mein kiraye baithyo
[Leaving my own home, I came to live on rent in your street] 
 
Biyaan to jaane bachon-bachon tere shehar ko
[Even every kid in your city knows about our story]
 
Par tere karke meri pehchaan bhi chhupaya baithyo
[But because of you, I have hidden my own identity]
 
Tu mera nasha, meri latt, meri dua tu
[You are my intoxication, my addiction, my prayer] 
 
Zindagi mein khelya main jo pehla-pehla jua tu
[You are the very first gamble I ever played in my life]
 
Itni zaroori, ab saans bhi na rahi meri
[Even my breaths are no longer that important to me]
  
Jitna zaroori mere liye ab hua tu
[As you become important to me]
 
 
[Hook]
 
 
Moh main tero 
[I am your attachment]
  
Tu meri maya
[You are my enchantment]
 
Door jo jaaun
[Whenever I go away from you]
 
Meri katra-katra bikhrai kaaya
[My body falling apart, piece by piece]
 
 
[Verse 2]
 
Rooh ki bhook teri kaaya ki koni
[My hunger is for your soul, not for your body.] 
 
Tooti janam-janam ki ya dori bhi koni
[The bond that has connected us across lifetimes has still not broken]
 
Ab atto-patto, naam-jaat tu hi hai mero
[Now my whereabouts, my name, my very identity—all of it is you.]
  
Meri aatma mein aur kathai jodi bhi koni
[I have not connected my soul with anyone else]
 
Bhoolke Ram mero, tilak lagaun tero
[Forgetting my god, I place the tilak of your name]
 
 
Mandir na jaaun, jap lyun bas naam tero
[I do not go to the temple; I simply chant your name]
 
Tu mero ang-ang, rang gai gerua
[you have dyed every part of my body in the color of saffron]
 
Main jogi tere prem mein
[I became an ascetic in your love] 
 
Tu ban gayi jog mero
[and you have become my spiritual path]
 
 
[Hook]
 
Moh main tero
[I am your attachment] 
 
Tu meri maya
[You are my enchantment] 
 
Door jo jaaun
[Whenever I go away from you]
 
Meri katra-katra bikhrai kaaya
[My body falling apart, piece by piece.]
 
 
[Outro] 
 
Uthe tadap karai dhadkan dhak-dhak
[A longing rises within me, and my heart beats dhak-dhak.]
 
 
Mile jhalak teri, dekhun tannai ek-tak
[When I catch a glimpse of you, I gaze at you without looking away.] 
 
Aaja baras ban barkha tu chhan-chhan
[Pour over me like rain, drop by drop]
 
Sookhi hai rooh meri, sookho mero tann-mann
[My soul, my body, and my spirit are all dry] 
 
Uthe tadap karai dhadkan dhak-dhak
[A longing rises within me, and my heart beats dhak-dhak.]
 
Mile jhalak teri, dekhun tannai ek-tak
[When I catch a glimpse of you, I gaze at you without looking away.]
